earlier_findings.disposition: Both genuine alternative omissions resolved by adding fixed private source spans to the original primary groups, without changing query text, IDs, category, family, split or prior first gold. Old draft remains a separate rejected snapshot.

performed_checks.revision_diff_whitelist: Two primary groups gain exactly one true alternative each; compatibility path projection gains the matching private path. Source language/metadata/repository annotations are clarified, including f0001 TOML. All other native fields remain the original values.
performed_checks.line_convention: UTF-8 half-open byte [start,end); line fields represent each byte endpoint's one-based line, not an inclusive displayed line range.
performed_checks.method: GitHub fetch_blob for complete fixed source/candidate bytes, direct upstream commit and untruncated tree reads, independent JavaScript SHA-256/byte-span/line/projection/delta/split controls, plus manual source and negative semantic review. No local executor or Cargo used.

rows.reason: Root Cargo workspace members and patch.crates-io paths directly answer the repository manifest question; package Cargo metadata is not equivalent. TOML is recorded as metadata, not an extra code-language claim.
IgnoredAny visit_seq and visit_map recursively request IgnoredAny until exhaustion. Visitor defaults instead return invalid_type.

Both public iterator MapDeserializer and private Content MapDeserializer store the pending value, take it and panic on missing next_key. Revision 2 includes both in one primary group. The MapAccess trait declaration is not the concrete implementation.

Both public iterator SeqDeserializer and private Vec::IntoIter SeqDeserializer run the post-visitor end check and report count+remaining versus consumed count. Revision 2 includes both. SeqAccess declarations do not implement this check.
OptionVisitor explicitly maps unit/none to None, payload deserialization to Some, and is passed to deserialize_option. Serialize Option implements the reverse direction.
Actual Serialize for Option<T> dispatches Some/None as queried. Deserialization is not an alternative. Matching documentation examples are not designated unrelated negatives.
The untagged generator buffers Content, constructs ContentRefDeserializer, filters skipped variants and generates first-success attempts plus common failure. The dispatcher only selects strategy.

RENAME_RULES/from_str and ParseError Display supply two explicitly required facets in one file. attr.rs invokes the owner but does not define the list/error formatting. File-only compatibility cannot prove both spans.
InPlaceSeed definition wraps &mut T, returns unit and directly calls T::deserialize_in_place. private/de.rs re-exports it; ExtendVec's append visitor is a distinct behavior.

The enum dispatcher splits at the first trailing untagged variant, constructs a tagged first attempt and dispatches all TagType cases. The untagged helper receives the attempt but does not own the split/strategy choice.

Public de::value BorrowedStrDeserializer satisfies the explicit namespace and borrowed callback. The private same-name implementation is a genuine behavioral match excluded only by that stated namespace; it is not falsely said to lack the behavior.
Serializer::collect_seq owns the exact length-hint -> serialize_seq -> serialize_element -> end call sequence. Slice Serialize only delegates to it. No graph-oracle support is claimed.
DeserializeOwned's trait and blanket implementation encode the higher-ranked for<'de> Deserialize<'de> requirement. InPlaceSeed is tied to a chosen lifetime and does not define that marker.
Cargo feature selection and cfg-gated macro re-export supply separate required configuration and code facets. Workspace patch membership alone does not implement either complete obligation.

source_grounded_limitations: Acceptance is source/gold review of exactly14 public DEV candidates; original checker/schema/lock CLI execution remains separate and is not inferred from JavaScript controls.
New .en02 bodies are independently authored; inaccessible historical .en01 bytes, approvals and global components are not represented as restored or equivalent.
No ranking, retrieval output, provider call or score was used to select or repair gold.
Compatibility is file-only. The two same-file f0012 facets and all native alternative spans retain existing scoring semantics, including the unchanged union-of-alternative-spans rule.
Graph constraints remain empty and do not certify graph correctness.
Full327 public global-family/component review and canonical projection remain pending a separate review;14 labels are not claimed statistically independent.
Six reserved Serde holdout slots and every unknown/protected holdout body remain unread and undrafted.
This does not close P8-002, certify a full approximately600 coverage plan, run heldout or grant G8 acceptance.
